simple.meaning: שָׁמִיר (Shâmîyr) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Joshua, Judges, 1 Chronicles, beginning at Joshua 15:48. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, death, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁמִיר (H8069) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows שָׁמִיר through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: שָׁמִיר (Shâmîyr) / H8069 is tracked through Joshua 15:48, Judges 10:1, Judges 10:2, 1 Chronicles 24:24. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

timeline.evidenceText: In the hill country, Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,
After Abimelech, Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar, arose to save Israel. He lived in Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim.
He judged Israel twenty-three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.
The sons of Uzziel: Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.
